label: Icon with Text
purpose: Grid of up to 6 icon+heading pairs (e.g. feature or benefit highlights)
_notes: One block instance renders up to 6 icon+heading pairs, numbered 1-6. Each pair only renders if its heading_N is non-empty, so use as many pairs as you want (2-4 is typical) and set every unused heading_N (and its icon_N) to an empty string "" — otherwise it silently renders with the placeholder text 'Heading'. icon_N must be a Material Symbols icon name (e.g. local_shipping, verified, favorite, autorenew, star, shield). icon_N_fill toggles solid vs outline icon style for that pair. image_N optionally replaces icon_N with an uploaded custom image (left empty by the AI per system prompt). There is no separate description/body text field — heading_N is the only visible copy per item. layout controls whether pairs stack icon-above-text (vertical), icon-beside-text (horizontal), or run icon+text inline in one line. All remaining real settings (grid columns, icon color/size, spacing, text size/alignment, desktop/mobile size overrides, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
